# komodo_builder (Resource)

Manages a Komodo builder (a server used to build Docker images).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "komodo_builder" "default" {
  name      = "default-builder"
  server_id = "Local" # or a komodo_server.<name>.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.

### Optional

- `server_id` (String) Server used for building (ID or name).
- `tags` (List of String) List of tag names to apply to this builder.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing builder by its Komodo ID.
terraform import komodo_builder.default 65a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1
```
